description: Get latest NPK nutrient readings (N, P, K, pH) for a block. Critical for detecting potassium crash in Block C.

configuration.query: FROM vineyard-npk | WHERE block_id == ?block_id | SORT timestamp DESC | LIMIT 5 | KEEP block_id, block_name, soil_nitrogen_mgkg, soil_phosphorus_mgkg, soil_potassium_mgkg, ph, timestamp
